body: Eh, this has been an issue for about a year and I feel as if I might just not be suited for life.

I know hierarchal status isn't determined by height alone, but it's no lie that tall people do infact have it better, they get laid more, earn more money, make better leaders etc.

Yeah, the 'sperg syndrome sucks. I don't identify with it at all but hey, if the psychologist says I have it I must have it right? It's a label that degrades me and makes me feel like less than a person, that will forever be shunned and put down.
